audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was given to Wukong at 3/10 while whys[4] says 'you own the 6 window'; Levels 3, first item and 2+ items were given to Ornn while the prose calls them even and a coinflip.
audit.why: Direct self-contradiction between the chart tokens and the whys text on rows 2, 4, 5 and 6; the packet chart agrees with the prose on every one.
audit.corrected: Rows 2, 5, 6 to Skill and row 4 to Ornn in both layers, ratings realigned (Level 6 from 3/10 to 7/10).

audit.why: Four spikes present: Wukong's level-2 all-in, Ornn at 3, Ornn at 6, Wukong on first bruiser item.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Wukong ability was ever named — 'his Q', 'the clone', 'his spin' throughout.
audit.why: Names per the packet: Stone Skin (P), Crushing Blow (Q, armour shred and an auto reset — the windup is the tell, not the cast), Warrior Trickster (W, the decoy), Nimbus Strike (E, the gap-closing dash), Cyclone (R, the knock-up spin). Nimbus Strike being a dash makes Volcanic Rupture's grounding the decisive lane tool.
audit.corrected: Named all five and stated the grounding interaction against Nimbus Strike.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers; none could be supplied.
audit.why: The brief's enemyKit is null for Wukong, so no per-rank cooldowns were available and none were invented.
audit.corrected: Rewrote the cooldown breakdown around which ability matters and why, without fabricating durations.

edits.before: - Wukong Nimbus Strike: matchup-defining — His engage dash. E-knock up after it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Nimbus Strike (E): his engage dash — your Q pillar grounds it, so hold Q for the step-up. - Warrior Trickster (W): the decoy; the real Wukong keeps moving. - Cyclone (R): knocks up, so never stand stacked with your wave.

edits.before: Track Wukong's Nimbus Strike: His engage dash. E-knock up after it. When it is down — W-E + R him.
edits.after: Nimbus Strike (E) is a dash and Volcanic Rupture grounds it — hold Q for his engage, not the wave.

edits.before: His engage dash. E-knock up after it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Nimbus Strike is his only gap-close — ground it with Q, then knock him up.

edits.before: That is Wukong's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Warrior Trickster leaves a decoy that copies him — check for damage before you commit.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Crushing Blow shreds armour, so raw armour is not the trade answer.

edits.before: Wukong's level-2 Q armor-shred plus E-dash all-in beats you while you have no W shield, no combo, and an empty mana bar.
edits.after: Crushing Blow's armour shred plus a Nimbus Strike dash beats you at 1 while you have no combo and an empty mana bar.

edits.before: Your R double knock-up cancels his spin (R) all-in and chains into E-Q-Brittle for the kill, so you own the 6 window.
edits.after: Your R knock-up beats Cyclone's all-in and chains into E-into-Q-pillar Brittle for the kill, so you own the 6 window.

notes: The brief's enemyKit for Wukong is null, so no per-rank cooldowns, ranges or costs were available; every edit here avoids numbers rather than inventing them. Ability names were taken from packet.enemyAbilities. Claims elsewhere in the text that Ornn's R or E 'cancels' Cyclone were softened to 'beats' because nothing in the available data confirms a knock-up interrupts it.
